description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kiribamunegama (Block 04), Polpitigama D/S Division,  Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 421477
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title settlement, cadastral maps, and determination of land ownership rights in various districts. The content focuses entirely on land registration and title claims without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
